title: Shared decision-layer building blocks
description: Definitions shared by the decision-layer contracts (docs/architecture/decision-layer.md section 4), referenced as urn:alixai:schema:decision:shared:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own. The decision layer is optional, bounded, non-generative and non-authoritative: nothing defined here describes an authorisation, a permission, an approval or a commit, and nothing may be added that does.

decisionType.title: Decision type
decisionType.description: What kind of bounded choice the scorer is asked to rank (master plan 8.5). capability_routing: which authorised capability a turn concerns. dialogue_act: confirmation, rejection, correction, cancellation or help detection. item_selection: one item of a short authorised list. action_selection: one of the already-permitted next actions. scope_classification: bounded out-of-scope and prompt-injection classification. path_verification: optional verification of an action, tool or response path. A value outside this list is rejected on decode: an unknown decision type fails closed and the controller path is used.

schemaVersion.title: Decision schema version
schemaVersion.description: The version of the decision-type contract a request or result follows. Exactly 1 in this release; any other value is rejected on decode, so a request or result from a different contract generation fails closed instead of being read loosely.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: A BCP 47 language tag such as it, en or pt-BR (2 to 3 letters, then up to three subtags of 2 to 8 letters or digits), at most 35 characters.

unitScore.title: Unit score
unitScore.description: A real number from 0 to 1 inclusive.

sha256.title: SHA-256 digest
sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

boundedScalar.title: Bounded scalar
boundedScalar.description: A single string (at most 512 characters), number, boolean or null. No nesting.
